nodes.label: 4 Mission-Critical Telemetry KPIs
nodes.rationale: Distance, Average Speed, Prior Dwell Time, and Composite Safety Index (0-100).

nodes.label: Real-Time Fleet State Deck
nodes.rationale: Active vessels state, operational corridors, and real-time risk scores.

nodes.label: Jensen-Shannon Divergence Predictability
nodes.rationale: Measures maritime route canalization predictability from 0.0 (uniform random) to 1.0 (deterministic corridor).

nodes.label: 3rd-Order Markov Chain Predictor
nodes.rationale: P(C_t+1 | C_t, C_t-1, C_t-2) transition matrices over Uber H3 Res 8 hexagonal cells.

nodes.label: Top-3 Hex Prediction Spectrum
nodes.rationale: Rank 1 Red (#ef4444), Rank 2 Orange (#f97316), Rank 3 Yellow (#eab308).

nodes.label: Point-to-Point Derived Kinematics
nodes.rationale: Derived speed, heading bearing, acceleration, and ROT calculated directly between consecutive pings.

nodes.label: MapConfig Zero-UI Exposure Standard
nodes.rationale: Basemap API keys must never be exposed or managed via UI dialogs or inputs.

nodes.label: Solid Sidebar Rule 2 Standard
nodes.rationale: Solid structural sidebar flush against edge with tactile translateX(6px) hover.

nodes.label: Universal Palantir App Shell
nodes.rationale: Single source of truth for header, navigation tabs, User 007 badge, and solid sidebar.
